subject: mathematics
question_text: If A is the matrix with rows (1, 0, 0), (2, 3, 4) and (5, −6, x), and det A = 45, then find x.

recall_prompt: Say how you would find x from the determinant.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: Expand the determinant
steps.margin_note: First mark. The top row is 1, 0, 0 — two zeros — so expanding along it leaves a single 2×2 minor. Keep x as a letter.
steps.memory_tip: The top row is 1, 0, 0 — two zeros — so expanding along it leaves a single 2×2 minor. Keep x as a letter.

recall.must_convey: That the determinant is expanded along the first row, which has two zeros, leaving 3x + 24.
accept: expand along the first row since it has two zeros and you get three x plus twenty four
only the one contributes so the determinant is three x plus twenty four
the two zeros kill the other terms leaving a single two by two minor
first row lo zeros unnai kabatti oke term, three x plus twenty four
expanding gives three x plus twenty four

steps.why: A row with two zeros saves work — expanding along it leaves a single 2×2 minor instead of three. Choosing the right row to expand along is the skill this question tests.
common_mistakes: Expanding along a row with no zeros and doing three times the work.
Substituting a guess for x before expanding.

steps.label: Solve for x
steps.margin_note: Second mark. Set the expansion equal to 45 and solve. Watch the double negative: 4 × (−6) = −24, and subtracting it ADDS 24.
steps.memory_tip: Watch the double negative: 4 × (−6) = −24, and subtracting it ADDS 24.

recall.must_convey: That 3x + 24 is set equal to 45 and solved to give x = 7.
accept: set three x plus twenty four equal to forty five so three x is twenty one and x is seven
three x equals twenty one so x is seven
three x plus twenty four equals forty five, x equals seven

steps.why: The minor is 3x − 4(−6), and the two minus signs make +24. Reading it as 3x − 24 gives x = 23, which is the standard wrong answer here.

insider_note: Expand along the first row, where two of the three entries are 0, so only the leading 1 contributes. That reduces the whole determinant to 3x + 24.
